name: Half-Life: Pocket DX
summary:
In 1998, Valve released Half-Life, a revolutionary first person shooter. Gordon Freeman, a theoretical physicist at a secretive research facility, finds himself fighting his way through an alien invasion. It is impossible to overstate Half-Life's influence in the realm of PC Gaming.

Half-Life: Pocket DX re-imagines Half-Life not as a shooter but as a side-scrolling platformer game. Black Mesa is lovingly recreated in 8-bit detail, from Anomalous Materials to Lambda Complex, and beyond. Players familiar with the original Half-Life will see a variety of recognizable locales interpreted in new and interesting ways.
